mode: offline synthetic privacy/boundary checks; no model inference or database security claim
checks: strict fresh projection removes unknown fields, names, stages, reasons and invalid durations
normal model and tool events contain no invoice, response, result, context or owner values
unknown model-selected tool names are redacted while the safe boundary reason survives
arbitrary exception text is discarded and typed metadata failures remain actionable
arbitrary provider error codes and authorization exceptions cannot leak into events
synchronous and asynchronous diagnostic sink failures do not alter success or failure
runtime extraction failures retain only an allowlisted stage and reason; no write service is invoked
hosted invoice sink logs only the safe projection and creates no diagnostic storage contract
